capability.title: Visual Factory
capability.summary: Brief in, reviewed imagery out. Owns the reuse-before-generate decision, prompt composition (routed per vertical), generation with fallback, and brand scoring before anything expensive happens downstream.

with.note: Always. Even when the brief says generate_first, the search result is recorded so the cost of NOT reusing is visible in the ledger.
This is mechanism (b) in action: the vertical profile's capability_bindings decide whether a product-studio, room, abstract or field-proof composer runs. No branch in this workflow names a vertical.
